The '''Berchestian Council''' was a [[Politics/Legends|political]] body on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]]. [[Raccyx Staffa]] was elected as a member of the Council before he blackmailing the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] into retirement and took his place.
